style: square album-cover composition, one clear focal point, rich atmosphere, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no border

cards.sands-of-qamar: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a bazaar-and-palace bidding game, warm sand, copper and lapis blue, lantern light, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark brown outline. a desert bazaar at dusk below a golden-domed palace, a brass oil lamp glowing on a carpet in the foreground, swirls of blue djinn smoke rising
cards.crown-city-smash: Bold hand-painted gouache illustration for a cheerful giant-monster city-brawl dice game, thick dark ink outline, saturated neon-night city colours, playful and a little menacing but never gory. a cheerful giant monster roaring on top of a neon downtown at night, glowing skyscrapers, a golden crown floating above the city
cards.nebula-aces: Hand-painted gouache sci-fi illustration for a starfighter duel game, deep indigo space, glowing engine light, retro-futurist, rich but not neon colours. two starfighters banking past each other in front of a glowing violet nebula, engine trails and distant asteroids
cards.doorkick-dungeon: Storybook gouache illustration for a cheerful, slightly grubby fantasy dungeon card game, warm torchlight against deep brown stone, thick dark-brown ink outline, matte paper texture. a heavy iron-banded dungeon door bursting open with dust and torchlight, a pile of treasure glinting on the stone floor
cards.shipwreck-isle: Tropical castaway gouache illustration for a co-operative island survival game, turquoise, sand, jungle green and driftwood colours, soft rim light, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark ink outline. a small jungle island at sunset with a broken ship wreck on the reef, a campfire and a palm-leaf shelter on the beach
cards.sunglaze: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a glazed-tile mosaic workshop game, jewel-bright glaze colours, warm kiln glow, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark ink outline. a sunlit tile workshop with a glowing kiln, stacks of jewel-coloured glazed tiles and a half-finished mosaic wall
cards.rampart-and-vine: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a medieval valley tile-laying game, green fields, stone towers and vines, warm afternoon light, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark brown outline. a green river valley with a walled stone town, vineyards on the hills and a winding road, warm afternoon light
cards.short-fuse: Workshop gouache illustration for a cheerful bomb-defusal crew card game, warm lamplight against cool blueprint blues, brass and copper wire, slightly wobbly dark ink outline, matte paper texture. a round cartoon bomb with a ticking dial on a blueprint-covered workbench, coloured wires and red-handled cutters under a desk lamp
cards.tidewake: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a sea-tile navigation game with giant sea leviathans, deep teal water, warm lantern light, foam and scales, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark navy outline. a small junk ship with lantern-lit sails crossing dark teal waves while a huge sea serpent rises from the foam
cards.hollowbough: Storybook watercolour and gouache illustration for a woodland city-building game, woodland critters and tree houses in autumn colours, soft brown outline, matte paper texture. a giant hollow autumn tree with little lit windows and rope bridges, woodland critters bustling around its roots
cards.thornbound-throne: Dark-fairytale court painting in deep green, crimson and tarnished gold, candlelit, painterly brushwork, rich shadows, no frame. an empty throne overgrown with thorny briars in a candlelit hall, a tarnished-gold crown of thorns resting on the seat
cards.kaiten-kitchen: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a cosy sushi card game, warm-brown ink outline with a slightly wobbly brush edge, soft rim light, matte paper texture. a cosy sushi bar conveyor belt carrying round plates of cute sushi characters with happy faces, warm paper lanterns
cards.lantern-dive: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a calm co-operative deep-sea card game, deep blue and teal water, a small warm golden lantern glow as the only strong warm light, visible gentle brush texture on matte paper, slightly wobbly dark navy ink outline. a diver with a brass lantern descending into a deep blue trench, glowing jellyfish and a sunken ruin below
cards.cauldron-fair: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a cosy fantasy-fair board game, warm brown ink outline with a slightly wobbly brush edge, soft rim light, matte paper texture, rich but warm colours. a bubbling cauldron at a lantern-lit village fair, colourful potion steam, striped market tents and ingredient bags
cards.final-approach: Hand-painted gouache illustration for a cosy cockpit game, chunky soft shapes with a slightly wobbly dark navy outline, matte paper grain, rich but warm colours, gentle rim light. a chunky cartoon airliner on final approach to a runway at golden hour, runway lights glowing, soft clouds
cards.mainhattan-nightrun: Painted neon-noir sci-fi illustration for an arcade skyline shooter, magenta and cyan glow against deep indigo night city, clean readable shapes. a sleek hover-car racing between glowing skyscrapers of a futuristic river city at night, neon reflections on the water
cards.mainhattan-overdrive: Painted neon-noir illustration for an arcade street racing game, magenta and cyan glow against deep indigo night, wet asphalt reflections, clean readable shapes. a low sports car speeding down a wet neon-lit boulevard at night past a glowing city skyline, light trails
